## Appendix ‐‐ Noro6 XVs32's edition

To be flankly honest, 
I wasn't going to setup this tool originally.  
Tho it takes forever for Noro6 to review my [Pull Request](https://github.com/noro6/kc-web/pull/18) so...

Anyway, just to let you guys know this is NOT the original Noro6 tool.  

There are 2 additions I added to the original tool:

---

### Close all tabs

There is now a button `Close All` on the top-right corner of the tool,
which closes all tabs, simple. 

<img alt="image" width="1067" height="120" src="https://private-user-images.githubusercontent.com/16824564/650885957-4662fcdb-c111-4dc5-a094-89e2e190b7c8.png?jwt=eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9..FxI8HWNQoJLMjbVkm8zPx_YraY7szaczWNV_mUiTXPc">

### Reverse look up

Under `Ship / Equipment` panel,  
there is now reverse lookup function,  
you can check which config using this ship/equipment. 

Extreamly useful when tidying up for expedition ship pool.
